entities.name: Reactant ester
observations: Contains a tert-butyl ester, C(=O)OC(CH3)3, on the chiral side chain.

entities.name: Carboxylic acid product
observations: Product retains the scaffold and stereocenter while replacing the tert-butyl ester with a carboxylic acid.

entities.name: tert-Butyl ester deprotection
observations: Net transformation is hydrolysis/acidolysis of a tert-butyl ester to a carboxylic acid, with loss of four carbons from C24H26N2O3S to C20H18N2O3S.
No new carbon-nitrogen or carbon-carbon bond is formed; the heteroaromatic scaffold is unchanged.

entities.name: Acidic tert-butyl ester cleavage
observations: Likely compatible reagent classes include trifluoroacetic acid, hydrochloric acid in an organic solvent, or sulfuric acid; select based on acid sensitivity of the scaffold.
Mild TFA conditions are the preferred first screen for a complex heteroaromatic substrate.
